import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('copper_r', len(product_sales))
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3, fontsize=8)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('Blues_d', len(age_sales))
bars2 = ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors2, edgecolor='darkblue', linewidth=1)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.bar_label(bars2, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3, fontsize=8)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors3 = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors3, 
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(payment_counts),
                                    shadow=True, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Average Order Value by Size and Takeaway Status (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
df['takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='takeaway_label', aggfunc='mean')
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Avg Order Value by Size & Takeaway Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(size_order, rotation=0)
ax4.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper left')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add a text box with key metrics
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
avg_order = df['total'].mean()
total_transactions = len(df)
metrics_text = f'Key Metrics:\nTotal Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f}\nAvg Order: ${avg_order:.2f}\nTransactions: {total_transactions:,}'
fig.text(0.98, 0.02, metrics_text, fontsize=9, ha='right', va='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
